purpose: Define explicit logical addresses used to locate canonical resources, namespaces, module instances or services without conflating address with addressed identity.

topics.name: Semantic Address Identity
topics.purpose: Define explicit logical addresses used to locate canonical resources, namespaces, module instances or services without conflating address with addressed identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Machine-significant addresses may themselves have explicit identity/profile.
semantics.target_rule: Address resolves to an exact target identity or exact unresolved state.
semantics.binding_rule: Address→target binding is explicit and revisionable.
semantics.mobility_rule: Target identity may remain stable when address/binding changes.
semantics.ambiguity_rule: One address cannot resolve ambiguously under one active resolution profile.
semantics.authority_rule: Resolvable address grants no access authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: same address resolves multiple targets silently
target move creates new semantic identity
